$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md.
title: Reusing a messageId with different content yields protocol_error_v2 invalid_message

rejection.rule: Exact replay of the same user_action_v2.messageId with identical payload returns the cached disposition; reuse with different content produces protocol_error_v2 invalid_message. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §7)
rejection.effect: The phone's contradictory retransmission is rejected. The actionId in the first transmission is not re-executed.

summary: The phone transmits a user_action_v2, then reuses the same messageId with a different actionId. The second transmission is a contradictory reuse, not a replay; it yields protocol_error_v2 invalid_message.

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

steps.note: A valid coaching state with two offered actions.
First transmission of messageId 99999999-...c1 invokes actionId 77777777-....
Same messageId, different actionId content. This is a contradictory reuse, not an exact replay. The desktop returns protocol_error_v2 invalid_message. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §7)

outcome: The contradictory retransmission is rejected with protocol_error_v2 invalid_message. Neither actionId is executed twice.
